from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI, APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel

class DecryptPayload(BaseModel):
    ciphertext_base64: str

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    app.state.kms_vaults = await load_active_kms_vaults()
    yield

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)
router = APIRouter(prefix="/crypto/vaults")

@router.post("/{vault_id}/decrypt-token")
async def decrypt_vault_token(
    vault_id: str,
    payload: DecryptPayload,
    request: Request,
    client: APIClient = Depends(get_authenticated_client)
):
    if not client.has_vault_permission(vault_id) and not client.is_kms_superadmin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: client lacks authorization for this KMS vault")

    vaults = request.app.state.kms_vaults
    if vault_id not in vaults:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="KMS vault identifier not loaded in lifespan")

    kms_instance = vaults[vault_id]
    plaintext = await kms_instance.decrypt(payload.ciphertext_base64)
    return {"vault_id": vault_id, "plaintext": plaintext}
